verdict.rationale: AFK's docs claim scoped OAuth tokens, encrypted secrets, automatic key rotation and full audit logs (afk-docs-9), plus role-based access controls, delegated approvals, and shared company context across the team (afk-docs-10) — directly matching centralized credential storage, sharing, and access control. However, there's no detail on per-credential granular assignment (who can use which specific credential) beyond general RBAC language, and no independent or hands-on verification exists (API/docs probes 404'd). Missing for 10: granular per-credential permission examples, independent/hands-on confirmation of the RBAC and secrets system, and a live audit-log or credential-sharing walkthrough.
